question: Where can the case split (A → X) ∧ (¬A → X) ⇒ X close an obligation in the repositories?

method.extraction: every remote branch of every repository; every unique .lean blob (tools/extract.sh)
method.scan: tools/winwin_scan.py: theorem headers parsed into hypotheses and conclusion; complementary pairs (H / ¬H, same conclusion, one level of Prop aliases); proved dichotomies A ∨ B with consumers A → X and B → X; explicit case-split tactics in proofs; one-sided conditionals on named open hypotheses
method.limits: syntactic: conclusions compared as normalized text; implicit hypotheses and term-mode case splits not seen; branch tips only (shallow clones)
